# Wrestle With Jimmy (WWJ)

Wrestle With Jimmy (WWJ) is Austin, Texas's premier Weezer cover band. The band performs the full Weezer catalog — with a focus on the Blue Album and Pinkerton — at venues, breweries, festivals, and private events across Austin and the greater Texas region.

## What We Play

WWJ performs the complete Blue Album (1994) front to back — My Name Is Jonas, No One Else, The World Has Turned and Left Me Here, Buddy Holly, Undone – The Sweater Song, Surf Wax America, Say It Ain't So, In the Garage, Holiday, and Only in Dreams.

The set also includes Pinkerton (1996) cuts — Tired of Sex, The Good Life, El Scorcho, and Pink Triangle — plus Hash Pipe and Island in the Sun (The Green Album, 2001), Beverly Hills (Make Believe, 2005), and Pork and Beans (The Red Album, 2008). Alongside the Weezer catalogue the band plays a rotating set of '90s and 2000s alt rock.

Sets run approximately 45–60 minutes and are built for live audiences who want the full Weezer experience delivered loud, tight, and with genuine enthusiasm.

## Where We've Played

The band has performed at 11 Austin venues since 2024 — Mohawk Austin, Hole in the Wall, Radio/East, Come and Take It Live, Still Austin Whiskey Co., Central Machine Works, The Far Out Lounge & Stage (Brisketfest 2025), Independence Brewing Company, Meanwhile Brewing Company, Oasis Brewing, and Bungalow — plus The Rock-Box in San Antonio.

## Upcoming Shows

- May 23, 2026 — The Rock-Box, San Antonio TX (ticketed via Stubwire)

## Booking

Wrestle With Jimmy is available for bookings at venues, festivals, corporate events, and private parties in Austin and across Texas. To inquire about booking, email: wrestlewithjimmyatx@gmail.com
